entries.topic: vc110 mandatory update bypass and Android long Agent chat/overlay message hides confirmation on small PDA
facts: Owner reports vc110 still shows 'Để sau' on update information dialog, although D166 approved forced updates for every legitimate signed Beta APK; also a long notification/message pushes XÁC NHẬN below small PDA screen with no scroll.

Source MainActivity.kt showUpdateAvailable gates mandatory only when manifest.minimum_version_code > BuildConfig.VERSION_CODE and otherwise shows Để sau, including an optional continuation for already authenticated sessions. Foreground update check can be deferred; login is blocked only for MANDATORY or FAILED.

Service /downloads/pda/manifest defaults PDA_MIN_VERSION_CODE_BETA to 104 after vc104, unless overridden; later signed vc109->vc110 alone does not make it mandatory. Live Beta override value was not independently readable.

docs/D166_APPROVED_BACKLOG.md explicitly requires every approved signed APK be mandatory, even without a critical/optional label, and bans Để sau, Back bypass, or subsequent business mutations on obsolete versions at a safe checkpoint. Current implementation deviates from that accepted rule.

CriticalOverlayService.kt buildCommandOverlay (MODE_PICKER_CHAT) creates TextView item.body with no scroll container; button XÁC NHẬN follows in a LinearLayout centered inside a full-screen overlay, so long text can push the button out of reachable bounds. Generic result overlay XML likewise lacks a dedicated ScrollView around body. Android update AlertDialog uses setMessage with release notes; hardware field layout not yet reproduced by tooling.

For MODE_PICKER_CHAT, pressing XÁC NHẬN only records local dismissed alert ID; restarting ends the in-memory overlay without an authoritative business ACK, and the alert may recur on redelivery. MODE_RESULT business result uses durable account-scoped ACK and restart is not an acknowledgement. Update installer/restart does not satisfy mandatory update.

A fix cannot be safely limited to changing release text: update floor/server enforcement, session safety/ACK and responsive dialog geometry are coupled. No Agent, WMS, quota, Stable, secret, provider or configuration mutations performed in this discussion.
alternatives: No-change/restart temporary workaround: chat overlay disappears on restart but does not prove read/ACK and underlying layout defect persists; rejected as permanent solution.

Raise mandatory floor alone to latest: may block old clients before a usable recovery UI, while existing authenticated session behavior remains lenient; do not deploy without safe staged code+channel integration.
